summary: Verified new Admin Moderation 'Icon edits' queue end-to-end on preview mock harness, plus full re-run of sync regressions and icon_api_test.mjs. All critical flows pass: overview card, nav+badge, waiting/reviewed tabs, detail pane (title, GitHub link, check banner, file sections, songs/profile/lyrics changes with +N/-N counts and diff lines), approve (with confirm/cancel) + reject (with reason textarea) flows, toasts, badge decrement, pane close via back/Escape (single Esc closes pane only, second Esc closes dashboard), refresh button, error state with retry when /api/icon not proxied, moderators correctly hidden from the Icon edits section, and mobile 390x844 layout (no horizontal overflow, footer buttons visible). Backend icon_api_test.mjs: 46/46 passed (includes merge-base check). Sync: twodev.py 11/11 scenarios 0 failed; spso.py / syncrl.py / pfedit_sync.py all errors=[].

issues: Shown message is 'Couldn’t reach Icon edits. Try again.' instead of the exact text from the spec ('Icon edits aren’t switched on for this site yet.'). This appears when the fetch is aborted (network error) vs. a 404 'not configured' response from the backend. Functionally correct (shows error UI, retry button, rest of dashboard still works); only the copy differs from the review request. Please confirm which copy is intended.

action_items: Optional: align the no-proxy error copy with the spec ('Icon edits aren’t switched on for this site yet.') if that was intended; current UI shows 'Couldn’t reach Icon edits. Try again.' which is still a valid error path.
critical_code_review_comments: Icon edits queue code (p9zzc.js) wires cleanly into admOpen/admPaint and keeps dashboard functional even when /api/icon fails; good separation of concerns.
Backend icon.mjs review() now correctly diffs vs merge_base_commit (test case for 'earlier approval not shown as a revert' passes).
Role gating confirmed: moderator role sees neither admin-icon-edits-card nor admin-nav-icons; admin sees both.
